primary_decision.statement: Which fixed account will the next package scan use?
primary_decision.primary_action: Confirm Bankhoes or Muisstil, then scan the tracking code.

items.label: Account selection and scan input
items.purpose: Make Muisstil the unambiguous secondary operator label directly before scanning.
items.consequence_of_omission: An operator could misidentify the secondary account before a package scan.

placement.justification: The selected account is a safety prerequisite to scanning.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: The account label and scan control remain in the first decision zone at each viewport.

items.label: Snapshot health
items.purpose: Retain existing readiness and recovery context without adding copy.
items.consequence_of_omission: The operator could not determine if scanning is safely available.

placement.justification: Health explains whether scanning can continue.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Health remains before worklists and does not replace the scan action.

items.demotion_reason: It remains supporting context while healthy.
